items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: He had a great influence on all piano players, you know?

ctx.x: Was it a conscious effort to resemble Earl Hines, do you think, or was it just the fact that there was some natural resemblance?
Well, there was a natural, but everybody around Chicago at that time -- excuse me -- admired Earl Hines. He had a great influence on all piano players, you know?
